privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Ocaq collects, uses, and protects personal data on this website.
privacy.intro: This policy explains how the Ocaq Public Association of Psychotherapists collects, uses, and protects personal data on this website. By using the site or sending the contact form, you acknowledge these terms.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: The data controller is the Ocaq Public Association of Psychotherapists. This website is the association’s public site, based in the Republic of Azerbaijan.
For questions about your data, you can reach us by phone, WhatsApp, or the contact form on this site.

sections.title: What data we collect
paragraphs: Browsing the site does not require your name, phone number, or email. When you send the contact form, we collect:
items: The language used to submit the request

sections.title: How we use the data
paragraphs: We use this information only to respond to your request, share information about our services, and arrange contact. We do not build marketing lists and we do not sell your data.
To stop spam, we may temporarily use technical data such as your IP address when you send the form. This is not stored with your message.

sections.title: Where it is stored and who we share it with
paragraphs: Contact form submissions may be stored in Google services (including Google Sheets) so we can reply. Those services may process data outside Azerbaijan.
If you follow links to WhatsApp, Instagram, or Google Maps, those platforms apply their own privacy policies. We do not control the data they collect.

sections.title: Cookies and similar technologies
paragraphs: This site does not set advertising or analytics cookies of its own. Language preference is kept in the page address.
Third-party embeds, such as the map on the contact page, may set technical cookies needed for those services to work.

sections.title: Therapy and clinical confidentiality
paragraphs: The website contact form is not a therapy session and is not a channel for emergency medical or psychological help. Information you write in the form is not part of a clinical record.
Clinical information gathered during therapy is kept under professional confidentiality, separately from this website.

sections.title: How long we keep data
paragraphs: We keep contact requests for as long as needed to answer you and for any related follow-up. After that, the data is deleted or stored in a form that no longer identifies you.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Under the personal data laws of the Republic of Azerbaijan, you may ask to access, correct, or delete your personal data. Contact us by phone, WhatsApp, or the contact form to make a request.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If we learn that information about someone under 18 was sent to us, we will delete it.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. The revised text is published on this page and the date above is changed.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: For privacy questions, use the contact page on this site, the phone number shown there, or WhatsApp.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.description: Rules for using the Ocaq website, including liability and content terms.
terms.intro: These terms govern use of the Ocaq Public Association of Psychotherapists website. By visiting the site, you accept them. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

sections.title: About the site
paragraphs: This site provides information about the association’s work, services, specialists, library, and initiatives. The content is informational and may be updated from time to time.

sections.title: Not medical advice
paragraphs: Texts, FAQs, and library materials on this site are general information. They are not a personal diagnosis, treatment plan, or a substitute for emergency care.
If you are in crisis, at risk of self-harm, or facing a medical emergency, contact emergency services. The contact form and WhatsApp are not emergency channels.

sections.title: Contact form
paragraphs: Please provide accurate details in the form. Sending a request is not automatic enrolment in a service or a therapy contract. Response times may vary with demand.

sections.title: Library and copyright
paragraphs: Translations and publications in the library belong to, or are published by, the Ocaq Public Association of Psychotherapists. You may read and download them for personal, non-commercial use.
Copying, republishing, commercial distribution, or altering the materials without permission is not allowed.

sections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: Texts, design, logo, photographs, and other materials on this site are protected by law. Copying or distributing them without prior written permission is not allowed.

sections.title: Acceptable use
paragraphs: You must use the site lawfully and respectfully. The following is not allowed:
items: Disrupting the site or attempting unauthorized access
Sending false, abusive, or unlawful information
Submitting someone else’s personal data without their consent

sections.title: Third-party services
paragraphs: Links to WhatsApp, Instagram, and Google Maps are provided for convenience. Those platforms have their own terms and privacy policies. We are not responsible for their content or availability.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: The site is provided “as is”. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect loss arising from downtime, outdated information, or third-party services failing to work.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: We may update these terms. Changes take effect when published on this page. Continued use of the site means you accept the updated terms.

sections.title: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Azerbaijan. Disputes are resolved as provided by law.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: For questions about these terms, use the contact page on this site, the phone number shown there, or WhatsApp.

frequency.question: How often does group therapy take place?

duration.question: How many months does it last?

groupSize.question: How many people are in a group?

speaking.question: Can we talk about our problems in front of others in the group?
speaking.answer: This is a very normal question. Speaking is not mandatory in group therapy. Sometimes just listening is healing. Over time, as a person feels safer, sharing naturally increases.

selection.question: How many participants are in a group and how are they selected?
selection.answer: Before joining, each participant has an individual intake meeting. Psychological state, readiness, and fit for the group format are assessed. The goal is to protect the safety of both the individual and the group.

communication.question: I struggle to communicate with people and my speech gets tangled — can you help?
communication.answer: Difficulty communicating and tangled speech are usually linked to social anxiety. When the brain signals "There is danger!", the speech center can block. In group therapy this is worked through in a real but supportive environment, and over time people begin to speak more freely.

development.question: You wrote it is for development — what exactly do you develop?
development.answer: In group therapy we mainly develop: self-expression, reducing social anxiety, setting boundaries, self-confidence, recognizing and managing emotions, and building healthy relationships.
